verdict.rationale: The only versioning signal is the `/v1/` prefix on the documented invoice endpoint (POST /v1/invoices/create_preview), which implies a versioned API surface. Official client libraries are also referenced. Nothing in the pack documents a versioning scheme, how versions are pinned, or a deprecation policy. Missing for 10: documented API versioning model (pinning and upgrade process), a published deprecation/sunset policy, changelog or upgrade guidance, and independent corroboration.
